name: append
sql:
/* edax:append */
WITH clock AS (
  SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000000)::bigint * 1000 AS recorded_at
),
current AS (
  SELECT coalesce(max(sequence), 0) AS version
  FROM "public"."edax_events"
  WHERE stream = $1::text
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO "public"."edax_events" (
    id, stream, sequence, aggregate_id, tenant, name, version, data,
    correlation_id, causation_id, occurred_at, recorded_at, extensions, metadata
  )
  SELECT
    d.id, $1::text, d.sequence, d.aggregate_id, d.tenant, d.name, d.version, decode(d.data, 'hex'),
    d.correlation_id, d.causation_id, d.occurred_at, clock.recorded_at, d.extensions, d.metadata
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(($3::text)::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS r(value, n)
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_record(r.value) AS d(
    id text, aggregate_id text, tenant text, sequence bigint, name text, version bigint, data text,
    correlation_id text, causation_id text, occurred_at bigint, extensions text, metadata text
  )
  CROSS JOIN clock
  CROSS JOIN current
  WHERE current.version = ($2::text)::bigint
  ORDER BY r.n
  RETURNING *
),
outbox AS (
  INSERT INTO "public"."edax_event_outbox" (event_id)
  SELECT id
  FROM inserted
  ORDER BY sequence
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'stored', (SELECT version FROM current),
  'events', coalesce(
    (
      SELECT json_agg(
        json_build_object(
          'id', e.id,
          'aggregate_id', e.aggregate_id,
          'tenant', e.tenant,
          'sequence', e.sequence,
          'name', e.name,
          'version', e.version,
          'data', encode(e.data, 'hex'),
          'correlation_id', e.correlation_id,
          'causation_id', e.causation_id,
          'occurred_at', e.occurred_at,
          'recorded_at', e.recorded_at,
          'extensions', e.extensions,
          'metadata', e.metadata
        )
        ORDER BY e.sequence
      )
      FROM inserted AS e
    ),
    '[]'::json
  )
)::text

name: catalog
sql:
/* edax:catalog */
SELECT coalesce(
  json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'table', w.logical,
      'kind', c.relkind,
      'columns', coalesce(
        (
          SELECT json_agg(
            json_build_object(
              'name', a.attname,
              'type', format_type(a.atttypid, NULL),
              'not_null', a.attnotnull,
              'default', a.atthasdef OR a.attidentity <> '' OR a.attgenerated <> '',
              'collation', co.collname
            )
            ORDER BY a.attnum
          )
          FROM pg_attribute AS a
          LEFT JOIN pg_collation AS co ON co.oid = a.attcollation
          WHERE a.attrelid = c.oid
            AND a.attnum > 0
            AND NOT a.attisdropped
        ),
        '[]'::json
      ),
      'unique', coalesce(
        (
          SELECT json_agg(
            json_build_object(
              'name', ic.relname,
              'columns', (
                SELECT coalesce(json_agg(ka.attname ORDER BY k.n), '[]'::json)
                FROM unnest(i.indkey::int2[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, n)
                JOIN pg_attribute AS ka ON ka.attrelid = c.oid AND ka.attnum = k.attnum
                WHERE k.n <= i.indnkeyatts
              ),
              'collations', (
                SELECT coalesce(json_agg(coalesce(kc.collname, '') ORDER BY k.n), '[]'::json)
                FROM unnest(i.indcollation::oid[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(oid, n)
                LEFT JOIN pg_collation AS kc ON kc.oid = k.oid
              ),
              'partial', i.indpred IS NOT NULL,
              'expressions', i.indexprs IS NOT NULL,
              'valid', i.indisvalid,
              'deferrable', EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM pg_constraint AS pc
                WHERE pc.conindid = i.indexrelid
                  AND pc.condeferrable
              )
            )
          )
          FROM pg_index AS i
          JOIN pg_class AS ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid
          WHERE i.indrelid = c.oid
            AND i.indisunique
        ),
        '[]'::json
      )
    )
  ),
  '[]'::json
)::text
FROM jsonb_to_recordset(($1::text)::jsonb) AS w(logical text, schema text, name text)
LEFT JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.nspname = w.schema
LEFT JOIN pg_class AS c ON c.relnamespace = n.oid AND c.relname = w.name AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p')

name: command_unpublished_count
command_unpublished_leased
sql:
/* edax:command_unpublished */
WITH lease_clock AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT clock_timestamp() AS now
),
held AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT owner, expires_at
  FROM "public"."edax_relay_leases"
  WHERE outbox = 'public.edax_command_outbox'
),
renewed AS (
  INSERT INTO "public"."edax_relay_leases" AS l (outbox, owner, expires_at)
  SELECT 'public.edax_command_outbox', $2::text, now + ($3::text)::bigint * interval '1 millisecond'
  FROM lease_clock
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM held)
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM held
       WHERE expires_at <= now
          OR (owner = $2::text AND expires_at < now + ($3::text)::bigint * interval '0.5 millisecond')
     )
  ON CONFLICT (outbox) DO UPDATE
  SET owner = EXCLUDED.owner,
      expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
  WHERE l.owner = EXCLUDED.owner
     OR l.expires_at <= clock_timestamp()
  RETURNING l.owner
),
lease AS (
  SELECT owner
  FROM renewed
  UNION ALL
  SELECT owner
  FROM held
  CROSS JOIN lease_clock
  WHERE owner = $2::text
    AND expires_at >= now + ($3::text)::bigint * interval '0.5 millisecond'
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'id', c.id,
  'idempotency_key', c.idempotency_key,
  'aggregate_id', c.aggregate_id,
  'tenant', c.tenant,
  'name', c.name,
  'version', c.version,
  'data', encode(c.data, 'hex'),
  'correlation_id', c.correlation_id,
  'causation_id', c.causation_id,
  'issued_at', c.issued_at,
  'extensions', c.extensions,
  'metadata', c.metadata
)::text
FROM "public"."edax_command_outbox" AS c
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lease)
ORDER BY c.position
LIMIT ($1::text)::bigint

name: saga_insert
sql:
/* edax:saga_insert */
WITH written AS (
  INSERT INTO "public"."edax_saga_instances" (saga, id, version, state, folded, completed, completed_at)
  VALUES (
    $1::text,
    $2::text,
    1,
    $3::text,
    $4::text,
    ($5::text)::boolean,
    CASE WHEN ($5::text)::boolean THEN clock_timestamp() END
  )
  ON CONFLICT (saga, id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING version
),
sent AS (
  INSERT INTO "public"."edax_saga_outbox" (
    saga,
    id,
    idempotency_key,
    aggregate_id,
    tenant,
    name,
    version,
    data,
    correlation_id,
    causation_id,
    issued_at,
    extensions,
    metadata
  )
  SELECT
    $1::text,
    c.id,
    c.idempotency_key,
    c.aggregate_id,
    c.tenant,
    c.name,
    c.version,
    decode(c.data, 'hex'),
    c.correlation_id,
    c.causation_id,
    c.issued_at,
    c.extensions,
    c.metadata
  FROM written
  CROSS JOIN jsonb_array_elements(($6::text)::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS r(value, n)
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_record(r.value) AS c(
    id text,
    idempotency_key text,
    aggregate_id text,
    tenant text,
    name text,
    version bigint,
    data text,
    correlation_id text,
    causation_id text,
    issued_at bigint,
    extensions text,
    metadata text
  )
  ORDER BY r.n
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'written', (SELECT version FROM written),
  'stored', (SELECT i.version FROM "public"."edax_saga_instances" AS i WHERE i.saga = $1::text AND i.id = $2::text),
  'completed', (SELECT i.completed FROM "public"."edax_saga_instances" AS i WHERE i.saga = $1::text AND i.id = $2::text)
)::text

name: save_snapshot
sql:
/* edax:save_snapshot */
WITH current AS (
  SELECT coalesce(max(sequence), 0) AS version
  FROM "public"."edax_events"
  WHERE stream = $1::text
),
saved AS (
  INSERT INTO "public"."edax_snapshots" AS s (stream, type_name, version, data)
  SELECT $1::text, $2::text, ($3::text)::bigint, decode($4::text, 'hex')
  FROM current
  WHERE ($3::text)::bigint <= current.version
  ON CONFLICT (stream) DO UPDATE
  SET type_name = EXCLUDED.type_name,
      version = EXCLUDED.version,
      data = EXCLUDED.data
  WHERE s.version <= EXCLUDED.version
)
SELECT version
FROM current
